text:
sam: Heads-up — customer reported a wrong action from the autorouter; an attempted refund ended up invoking `redeem_voucher` instead of `process_refund`.

sam: Payload the front-end sent (redacted):
```json
{ "customer_id": "C-123", "amount": 1000, "currency": "USD", "action": "refund", "payment_type": "store_credit" }
```

auto-router-bot: [info] matched tool 'redeem_voucher' (score=0.78) vs 'process_refund' (score=0.67). Top feature: alias("store_credit") -> voucher. Routing trace id: rt-9a7c.

marta: Huh. Our refund tool expects `refund_method` normally — where did `payment_type` come from?

sam: Legacy support UI field. Front-end uses `payment_type` for a few flows. Customer clearly asked for a refund, not voucher redemption.

ryan: Repro on staging: `curl -X POST /v1/invoke -d @payload.json` with that payload triggers `redeem_voucher`. I can reproduce locally.

nina: Quick mitigation options:
- add schema requirement for `process_refund` (e.g., require `refund_reason` or `refund_method`),
- blacklist mapping `payment_type` -> voucher in alias table,
- add an account-level override to force `process_refund` for this customer.

marta: Also worth penalizing matches that rely mostly on numeric fields (amount/currency) instead of explicit method fields.

ryan: I'll open a small PR to: 1) make `refund_method` required for `process_refund` routing, 2) remove `payment_type` -> voucher alias, and 3) add a short test case to autorouter eval harness. ETA ~2h. @sam can you confirm we should push to staging first?

sam: Yes please push to staging and re-run the failing invocation for the customer. We have an SLA note; they need it reprocessed.

marta: I'll add a regression test to prevent this exact pattern from slipping through. Also logging more context for future audits (ui_field -> original_payload).

auto-router-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for branch ryan/autorouter-fix — build #8421 started (trace rt-9a7c)

ryan: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/autorouter/pull/12345 — includes changelog and eval results.

sam: Filing customer follow-up and escalation note. Requeue request once deploy green. :memo:

marta: Added eval harness test and a small synthetic that uses `payment_type: "store_credit"` to assert `process_refund` wins.

ryan: Will requeue and post rerun logs here after deploy completes.

sam: Thanks team — will update customer when re-run succeeds. :white_check_mark:
